episodes.name: Part 1
episodes.overviewEn: Steve Trevor crash lands on an island paradise and is pursued by two women in weaponized jeeps before Wonder Woman captures him using a stylized car that turns invisible.

episodes.name: Part 2
episodes.overviewEn: As the two women confront Wonder Woman about interrogating Steve Trevor, Giganta awakes and emerges from the water taking the jeeps as roller skates.

episodes.name: Part 3
episodes.overviewEn: Wonder Woman defeats Giganta by sending her crashing into the ocean and saves Steve Trevor.
